# CA Shreya Jain

> CA Shreya Jain is a practising Chartered Accountant in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India, and a Partner at Prakash S. Jain & Co. (in practice for more than 39 years) since September 2016. Qualifications: CA (ICAI), CS (ICSI), LL.B., FAFD (ICAI). Practice: corporate and personal tax compliance, income tax assessments and appeals, tax planning for domestic and foreign clients, company incorporation, RBI compliances and forensic audit.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Who is CA Shreya Jain?
  A: CA Shreya Jain is a practising Chartered Accountant in Indore and a Partner at Prakash S. Jain & Co. since September 2016. The firm has been in practice for more than 39 years. CA Jain also holds Company Secretary (CS), LL.B. and FAFD qualifications.
- Q: What does CA Shreya Jain specialise in?
  A: Corporate and personal tax compliance, income tax assessments and appeals, tax planning for domestic and foreign clients, company incorporation and secretarial matters, RBI compliances and forensic audit.
- Q: Can CA Shreya Jain represent me in an income tax appeal?
  A: Yes. CA Shreya Jain handles income tax assessments and appeals before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) and the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal.
- Q: Does CA Shreya Jain advise NRIs and foreign clients?
  A: Yes. The practice covers foreign tax, NRI taxation, DTAA relief, Form 15CA / 15CB and RBI / FEMA compliance for foreign investment into India.
- Q: Where can I meet CA Shreya Jain?
  A: At the office of Prakash S. Jain & Co., 319/320, Manas Bhavan, R.N.T. Marg, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452001. Call +91 98260 52751 to fix a time.
